name: quarter
description: Reference quarter of the observation, from 1 to 4
observations: Derived from the ABS mid-quarter month: February is quarter 1, May is 2, August is 3 and November is 4.

name: month
description: Reference month of the observation, from 1 to 12
observations: The ABS mid-quarter month, always February, May, August or November.

name: occupation_major_code
description: ANZSCO major group code, from 1 to 8
observations: Not published in the cube: attached from the ANZSCO (2013) v1.2 major group list, asserted to cover every observed label.
original_name: Occupation major group of main job: ANZSCO (2013) v1.2

name: occupation_major
description: ANZSCO major group of the main job
observations: ANZSCO (2013) v1.2, carried by ABS across the whole history of the cube. A dedicated ANZSCO directory does not exist yet in br_bd_diretorios_au and is future work.
original_name: Occupation major group of main job: ANZSCO (2013) v1.2

name: occupation_classification
description: Occupation classification the labels belong to
observations: Constant at ANZSCO (2013) v1.2 across the whole history of this ceased release. Carried explicitly so that the OSCA-coded rows ABS begins publishing from the September 2026 reference period remain distinguishable in the same column.

name: status_in_employment
description: Status in employment of the main job, such as employee with paid leave entitlements or owner manager of an incorporated enterprise
observations: Finer than the status_in_employment column of the sibling monthly table, which carries a single rolled-up employee category; joining the two requires rolling the three employee categories up first.
original_name: Status in employment of main job

name: employed_full_time
observations: Converted from ABS thousands to absolute persons

name: employed_part_time
observations: Converted from ABS thousands to absolute persons

name: hours_worked_full_time
description: Total hours actually worked in all jobs by persons employed full-time
observations: Converted from ABS thousands of hours to hours
original_name: Number of hours actually worked in all jobs (employed full-time) ('000 Hours)

name: hours_worked_part_time
description: Total hours actually worked in all jobs by persons employed part-time
observations: Converted from ABS thousands of hours to hours
original_name: Number of hours actually worked in all jobs (employed part-time) ('000 Hours)
